title: Lead Data Architect
content_clean:
Headquartered in Lachen near Zurich, Switzerland, the Octapharma Group is a leading company in the worldwide market for therapeutic human proteins. Working at Octapharma means to have an opportunity to contribute to our common goal – developing lifesaving therapies to improve patients’ lives.

We are seeking

A highly motivated professional to join the corporate IT team as Lead Data Architect. In this newly created position, you will lead the implementation of the new data platform in Octapharma group. You will work together with an international team of business and IT team members on delivering high value data use cases.

Your main responsibilities and opportunities

Define the future data architecture, technical framework, and data governance

Collaborate and coordinate with multiple departments, stakeholders, partners, and external vendors

Translate business requirements into technical specifications, including data streams, integrations, transformations, databases, data lakes, ML, and data warehouses

Ensure that solutions exhibit high levels of performance, security, scalability, maintainability, appropriate reusability, and reliability upon deployment

Your Profile

Enterprise-scale technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, data models and technology management

Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with deep subject matter expertise in some of the following areas:

Data Platform

Cloud solutions

SQL, Azure SQL

NoSQL data bases (Cosmos DB)

Big Data and Data Warehouses including Azure Analytics,

Advanced Analytics including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Bricks, visualization tools as PowerBI, Qlik

Data Science

Machine Learning including Azure ML, ML Server, Python

Artificial Intelligence

Bachelor or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field

Previous 5+ years’ experience in data architecture and data science.

You bring a drive for excellence and a positive “can do” approach.

Our offer

Develop and grow a professional career in and exiting, challenging and international environment

A responsible and varied job with active participation in the highly complex IT landscape

And attractive salary and benefits package

A skilled, motivated and committed team

How to apply

Please apply online in English describing your interest, expected salary, and enclosing your CV, references and/or recommendation letters.

title: Data Analyst / Scientist
content_clean:
Burckhardt Compression ist der weltweite Marktführer im Bereich von Kolbenkompressorsystemen. Als einziger Hersteller und Servicedienstleister bietet das Unternehmen eine komplette Reihe von Kolbenkompressortechnologien und Services an. Die kundenspezifisch ausgelegten Kompressorsysteme werden in den Bereichen Gasförderung und -verarbeitung, Gastransport und -lagerung, Raffinerie, Chemie und Petrochemie sowie in Industriegas und der Wasserstoffmobilität und -energie eingesetzt. Mit führender Technologie, einem breiten Portfolio an Komponenten sowie einem vollumfänglichen Serviceangebot unterstützt Burckhardt Compression seine Kunden weltweit, die auf ihre Bedürfnisse zugeschnittene Lösung für ihre Kolbenkompressorsysteme zu finden. Seit 1844 schaffen hochqualifizierte Mitarbeitende Spitzenlösungen, um in der Gasverdichtung Massstäbe zu setzen.

For our newly created department we are looking for an initiative and committed personality as a

Data Analyst / Scientist (M/F/D)– Let’s create the insights for smart compression together 100%

At Burckhardt Compression, we are the leading experts for reciprocating compressor systems, trusted by clients across industries and the globe. Now, we are going a large step further and are creating an interdisciplinary team to create industrial compression’s digital future. This is your chance to create something entirely new and work in an agile, data-driven and fast-paced environment with the network and benefits of an industry-leading company.

Who we are looking for

We are building smart solutions that range from connecting and monitoring compressors all the way to optimizing operations, predicting and automating repairs. To do that, we need you, a data analyst, to be part of our newly established team. To succeed in this position, you should have a university degree in data or software engineering or a quantitative field, a proven track record and a passion to generate actionable insights for customers.

Whatyoucanexpect

Build the future of industrial compression solutions together with a newly established interdisciplinary and data-driven team

Initiate and conduct data analyses based on machine, production and service data and recognize patterns and correlations from our data streams

Use the data provided to generate descriptive, visualize and meaningful insights

Integrate technical solutions into business contexts and explore internal and external needs and translate them into data requirements

Work on machine learning and artificial intelligence projects (e.g., automated decision making, improvement of process quality and efficiency); supervised and unsupervised learning

Work with cross-divisional teams in an agile setup

You will be working in systems SAP (R3, BW), Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Microsoft BI, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Microsoft AZURE, Amazon AWS

Statistical modelling and experiment design

Whatyoushould bring

Degree in computer science, applied mathematics, statics or related quantitative field, or related field and/or experience in lieu of a degree

Experience preferably in an industrial company

Comfortable using cloud-based solutions

Experience or minimum willingness to learn the Analytical problem-solving skills and ability to assimilate complex information

Proven track record in data analysis, machine learning, statistical modeling, artificial intelligence and related approaches

Programming experience in modern data-oriented languages (e.g., Python)

Willingness to acquire additional system/technical knowledge as needed

Fluent in English, German is a plus

Experience in working with Microsoft Azure and/or other cloud-based environments

Experience with agile and customer-centered development approaches is a plus

Experience to work in an international organization and in multi-cultural teams

Translate data driven insights into decisions and actions

What we are offering

We are offering exciting technical and business challenges and development opportunities within a diversified and international environment. You can expect a competitive salary package, attractive working conditions, such as the opportunity to work some days remotely from home. You can also expect a pragmatic, open company culture. If you already have a Swiss work permit or are a citizen of the EU, we look forward to receiving your meaningful application.

Do you like what you see?

Are you excited to shape the future digital offerings for one of Switzerland's largest mechanical engineering companies? Then we are looking forward to getting to know you.

We look forward to receiving your complete application documents.

Data Engineer
Job ID: 
 56701
Location:
Lachen, CH
Job Level: 
 Professionals
Job Category: 
 IT
Employment Type: 
 Permanent position
Career Level:
Do you want to combine the opportunities that a global company provides with the benefits of a family-owned business? Headquartered in Lachen near Zurich, Switzerland, the Octapharma Group is a leading company in the worldwide market for therapeutic human proteins. Working at Octapharma means to have an opportunity to contribute to our common goal – developing lifesaving therapies to improve patients’ lives.

What's the best thing about working with us?

You help save lives - Every day is meaningful as we produce life-saving medicines
Family values - Long-term perspective for employees and relationships
Be rewarded with an attractive salary and benefits package
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization
Skills development - We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions

What will you be doing as Data Engineer?

Designing and Implementing Data Solutions: Utilize Azure data services to design and implement scalable data architectures. This includes setting up and maintaining Azure Data Lakes, Azure SQL Databases, and Azure Synapse Analytics.
Data Integration and Management: Develop ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes using Azure Data Factory to integrate data from various sources, ensuring data quality and consistency across the manufacturing process.
Real-Time Data Processing: Employ Azure Stream Analytics for real-time data processing, enabling immediate insights and actions based on manufacturing data streams.
Building Predictive Models: Use Azure Machine Learning to build and deploy predictive models that help optimize manufacturing processes and predict outcomes, enhancing decision-making capabilities.
Ensuring Data Compliance and Security: Implement and maintain data security and compliance measures in line with pharmaceutical industry regulations, utilizing Azure's security features.
Collaboration and Training: Work closely with IT and manufacturing teams to integrate and optimize data solutions. Provide training to staff on new data tools and processes.

Who are you?

Educational Background: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
Azure Expertise: Proven experience with Microsoft Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL Database, etc.) and Azure certifications (such as Azure Data Engineer Associate) are highly desirable.
Data Engineering Experience: At least 3 years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on data integration, data warehousing, and ETL processes.
Knowledge in Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning concepts and experience using Azure Machine Learning to build and deploy models.
Plus but not required: Industry Compliance Understanding: Knowledge of data privacy and security standards in the pharmaceutical industry, with an understanding of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and related regulatory requirements.

Apply Today!

If you have questions about the position, contact Ms. Claudia Vignau, Recruiter; +41 55 451 21 35.

If you proceed in the process

We will endeavor to review your profile as quickly as possible and provide you with feedback
The next step is to conduct a phone interview, which takes about 30 minutes.
Would you like to get to know us better? Learn more about us on our website and follow us daily on LinkedIn!
About Octapharma
Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines.
Octapharma employs nearly 12,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 118 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care.
Octapharma has seven R&D sites and five state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany and Sweden, and operates more than 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. Octapharma has 40 years of experience in patient care.
For more information, please visit www.octapharma.com
